outcome: normal ranges for IL-6, TNF-alpha, and CRP in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 162 healthy term neonates born at the Mount Hope Women's Hospital (MHWH), Trinidad
finding: The normal ranges for IL-6, TNF-alpha, and CRP in umbilical cord blood for healthy term Trinidadian neonates were 0-16.4 pg/mL, 0-29.4 pg/mL, and 0-12.4 mg/L, respectively.
